description: This Java class implements the <webapp-property-to-field> element, which retrieves a property value from a resource (properties file or resource URL) and assigns it to a specified field within a mini-language execution context. It handles resource loading, property expansion, and default value fallback, and is part of the OFBiz mini-language method operations.

classes.name: WebappPropertyToField
classes.description: Implements the <webapp-property-to-field> mini-language element, retrieving a property from a resource and mapping it into a context field.

classes.name: WebappPropertyToFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of WebappPropertyToField.

methods.description: Constructor parsing the XML element to initialize attributes, including validations.

methods.description: Executes the property retrieval logic during method invocation, reading from resource and setting the field.
